event:
I withdrew the finding: a generic register test library exists and is enabled on the blocks I checked.

The shared file `hw/dv/tools/dvsim/tests/csr_tests.hjson` defines `{name}_csr_rw` and `{name}_csr_bit_bash`. Both run over every register of a block. 28 IP sim configs import that file, including aes, hmac and kmac. The finding doesn't name its block, so I couldn't confirm which of these it maps to.

I did not read the csr_rw or csr_bit_bash sequence code, so I did not confirm the checks themselves. I also found no direct `csr_mem_rw_with_rand_reset` entry under aes, hmac or kmac, so that third suite is not confirmed for those blocks.
